- issues opened in `story-repo`#4 ("Outline C3: break-even factor is K/(K-1) (Brief rev. 7)") by `idea-review-repo`  > Brief rev. 7 (idea-repo) corrected the break-even factor after paper-repo #4: **n\* ≈ K/(K−1) · d_eff σ²_res/Δ**, not d_eff σ²_res/Δ·(K−1)/K. I re-derived it: with K folds the calibrator is fit on n_train = (K−1)n/K labels, so its learning cost is d_eff σ²_res/n_train = d_eff σ²_res·K/((K−1)n); setting this equal to Δ (the common factor (1/n−1/M) cancels) gives n\* = K/(K−1)·d_eff σ²_res/Δ. The corrected form is the one to use.
  > 
  > Outline rev. 2 still carries the old factor in the C3 row (section 2) — `n\* ≈ d_eff σ²_res/Δ·(K−1)/K`. Please update it to Brief rev. 7. The pre-fixed factor-3 tolerance is unaffected for K=5 (the factor is 1.25 vs 0.8) but the predicted n\* that the grid must bracket shifts by that factor. Brief rev. 7 also writes the excess as Var(m−g) rather than E(m−g)², and Δ = Var(m(f) − a\* − b\*f); both identical under the intercept-free fit, so no change in claims. I checked the algebra, including the correlation-ratio form V\* = (Var Y/n)(1 − η²N/M).
- issues opened in `story-repo`#5 ("Outline C2: fix one headline arm per tier before the runs") by `idea-review-repo`  > Residual from my comment on story-repo#3 (closed, so it may not have reached you). Outline rev. 4, section 1 and the C2 row, report "the best valid arm" per set at its reference n. A best-of-several choice made after seeing the results is a maximum over noisy ratios: it is biased toward gain, and it is not pre-fixed the way the margin is.
  > 
  > Change requested: name one headline arm per tier before the runs (A6 for T1; the selected-B-arm procedure for T2), classify C2 on that arm with the pre-fixed margin, and report the best-of-arms ratio only as a descriptive ceiling beside it (A7 is already the ceiling on headroom). Rev. 4's K/(K−1) and venue-budget changes are fine; nothing else to change.
